tournament.name: Fuguete Champ 248 - Play Point P/ Top 10

decks.notes: The main focus of this Pauper Mono Blue Aggro deck is to quickly establish a board presence with low-cost creatures like Delver of Secrets and Tolarian Terror, supported by spells like Brainstorm and Counterspell to control the game. This deck aims to disrupt the opponent's strategy with counterspells like Spell Pierce and Dispel, while also utilizing card draw and deck manipulation with cards like Thought Scour and Ponder. The inclusion of Lórien Revealed provides additional card advantage, allowing the player to stay ahead in the game and overwhelm the opponent with aggressive threats.

This deck focuses on using a combination of removal spells, creatures with graveyard synergy, and life gain to control the game and outvalue the opponent. The key strategy involves disrupting the opponent's game plan, while generating card advantage and recurring threats from the graveyard. The deck also includes ways to gain life and stabilize against aggressive decks, making it versatile in various matchups. The Golgari / Jund color combination allows for flexibility in handling different threats and adapting to different game states.

The deck focuses on filling the graveyard with creatures using cards like Ainok Wayfarer and Satyr Wayfinder, then reanimating them using Exhume and Dread Return to quickly overwhelm the opponent with powerful creatures like Troll of Khazad-dûm and Lotleth Giant. The inclusion of cards like Gnaw to the Bone helps to stabilize against aggressive decks, while Malevolent Rumble can clear the board to set up for a massive swing. The deck utilizes the graveyard as a resource and aims to outvalue the opponent with its reanimation combo.

The main focus of this deck is to swiftly deal damage to the opponent through aggressive creature attacks and burn spells. By utilizing cheap creatures and efficient burn spells like Lightning Bolt and Fireblast, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent before they have a chance to stabilize. Faithless Looting and Grab the Prize help with card advantage and deck filtering, while Highway Robbery provides additional reach and resources. Overall, this aggressive burn strategy aims to close out the game quickly and efficiently before the opponent can mount a defense.

The main focus of this deck is to generate a large amount of mana with High Tide in order to create a powerful combo. The deck includes cards that help find High Tide, generate extra mana, and recur important spells. By utilizing cards like Impulse, Snap, and Compulsive Research, the deck aims to set up its combo quickly while controlling the board with counterspells like Negate. The inclusion of creatures like Archaeomancer and Sunscape Familiar help provide additional value and support for the combo strategy. Overall, the deck seeks to win through efficient mana generation and powerful combos.

The main concept of this Aggro - Jund deck is to overwhelm the opponent with a combination of creature aggression and removal spells. The deck contains a mix of efficient creatures like Nyxborn Hydra and Krark-Clan Shaman, along with removal spells like Cast Down and Galvanic Blast to control the board. Cards like Refurbished Familiar and Writhing Chrysalis provide additional value and card advantage. The deck also includes some artifact hate with Nihil Spellbomb and Toxin Analysis to disrupt opponents' strategies. Overall, the deck aims to pressure opponents while maintaining control of the battlefield.

The deck focuses on using low-cost aggressive creatures like Sneaky Snacker and Guttersnipe to deal damage to the opponent quickly, while also utilizing burn spells like Lightning Bolt, Lava Dart, and Fiery Temper to finish them off. The deck includes card draw spells like Faithless Looting and Manamorphose to maintain hand advantage and keep up the pressure. Grab the Prize and Highway Robbery further contribute to the aggressive strategy by either stealing opponents' resources or generating additional card advantage. Fireblast serves as a powerful finisher to quickly close out games.

The main concept of this Pauper Rakdos Aggro deck is to quickly overwhelm the opponent with low-cost aggressive creatures like Voldaren Epicure, Sneaky Snacker, and Kitchen Imp, while utilizing burn spells like Lightning Bolt, Fiery Temper, and Chain Lightning to finish off the opponent. Faithless Looting helps with card selection and filling the graveyard for potential graveyard interactions, while Grab the Prize and Highway Robbery provide additional creature removal and disruption. Alms of the Vein and Vampire's Kiss help gain life to stay in the game longer, while the mana base is optimized for consistent aggressive plays.

The main idea of this deck is to quickly establish a defensive board while efficiently ramping up mana through creatures like Wild Cantor and Gatecreeper Vine. Once enough mana is available, the combo is activated by using Balustrade Spy to mill cards from the top of the library, allowing for a possible win condition with cards like Lotleth Giant. The deck also includes cards like Dread Return for graveyard recursion and Lead the Stampede for card advantage, providing a well-rounded strategy for a Pauper 1 vs 1 format.

The main focus of this deck is to assemble the High Tide combo as quickly and efficiently as possible. By generating extra mana with High Tide and untapping lands with cards like Hidden Strings and Psychic Puppetry, the deck aims to generate a large amount of mana to cast powerful spells like Ideas Unbound and Pieces of the Puzzle. This combo-centric strategy allows the player to overwhelm their opponent with a flurry of spells and card advantage, ultimately leading to victory.

The main focus of this deck is to aggressively deal damage to opponents using low-cost creatures and spells in order to win the game quickly. With a mixture of direct damage spells, lifelink creatures, and card draw to maintain momentum, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent before they can establish their own board presence. The inclusion of land that provides both mana fixing and life gain helps to ensure the deck can continue its aggressive strategy without running out of resources.

The main idea of this deck is to overwhelm the opponent with a fast and disruptive Mono Blue Aggro strategy. By using low-cost creatures like Faeries and Ninjas, along with countermagic and card draw, the deck aims to maintain board control and pressure the opponent early in the game. The inclusion of disruptive cards like Force Spike and Spellstutter Sprite adds to the deck's ability to disrupt the opponent's plans, while cards like Snap and Of One Mind help keep the momentum going. The goal is to outpace and outmaneuver the opponent to secure a quick victory.

This Rakdos Aggro deck focuses on fast and aggressive creature plays with low mana cost and high damage output. It also includes plenty of burn spells like Lightning Bolt and Galvanic Blast for direct damage. The deck utilizes cards like Faithless Looting and Grab the Prize for card draw and graveyard manipulation. The mana base includes a mix of Mountains, Swamps, and artifact lands to ensure a consistent mana curve. The goal is to overwhelm the opponent early in the game and finish them off quickly with a combination of creatures and burn spells.

The deck focuses on aggressive, fast-paced gameplay by utilizing efficient low-cost creatures and burn spells to quickly chip away at the opponent's life total. The goal is to overwhelm the opponent with a steady stream of creatures and direct damage spells, aiming to end the game before the opponent can stabilize. With a mix of creatures that can pump up the team's power and direct damage spells to finish off the opponent, the deck aims to win through relentless aggression and burst damage.

The main idea of this deck is to control the game by utilizing the Urzatron lands to generate a large amount of mana. This allows you to cast powerful creatures like Maelstrom Colossus and Wretched Gryff, along with other threats like Nyxborn Hydra and Annoyed Altisaur. The deck also includes ways to search for specific lands with cards like Expedition Map and Crop Rotation, as well as ways to draw cards and fix your mana with Prophetic Prism and Ancient Stirrings. Finally, there are some removal and recursion spells like Pulse of Murasa to help you stay ahead in the game.

This deck focuses on flooding the board with small, cheap creatures to overwhelm the opponent quickly. By playing aggressive white creatures like Thraben Inspector and Kor Skyfisher, backed up by anthem effects such as Inspiring Overseer and Guardians' Pledge, this deck aims to go wide and attack aggressively. With cards like Battle Screech providing additional token generation, this deck can quickly build a formidable army of creatures. The inclusion of some life gain with cards like Lunarch Veteran and Dawnbringer Cleric helps to sustain the early aggression and keep the pressure on the opponent.
